# Your 80s crush is a left-wing radical: Molly Ringwald gives warning to Trump supporters
Actress Molly Ringwald declared the Trump administration a fascist government and warned supporters of its immigration policies **[will be deemed collaborationists, facing treason-like guilt when leftists regain power,](https://substack.com/redirect/b0fa9f5c-9ce1-47c5-901d-4db93a6fdbd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** drawing parallels to post-Nazi France.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1162a7cc-8891-4b90-9cd4-27086c3d8dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Fascist label applied boldly** Ringwald insisted the current U.S. government under Trump is already fascist, not merely becoming one, and accused ICE of brutalizing people in a fiery social media video rant.
* **Collaborationist warning issued** She urged against supporting ongoing policies, predicting Trump backers will be seen as collaborationists akin to those in Nazi-occupied France who were later prosecuted as criminals after liberation.
* **Sundance red carpet fears** At the 2026 Sundance premiere of her film Run Amok, Ringwald told Variety it feels dangerous to speak out yet insisted Americans risk losing core democratic values if silence continues.

Peter,

First, seven House Democrats cowardly voted to increase ICE funding even
more after Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries refused to whip votes against
it. This was after thousands of ICE agents invaded Minnesota and unleashed
violence, killing Renee Good.

Then, a second civilian in Minneapolis was murdered by ICE agents, who
continue to wreak havoc and violate the constitutional rights of
Minnesotans with impunity.

Now, the Senate is voting on an appropriations bill with more ICE funding
this week, and Republicans need 10 Democratic senators to vote with them
in order for the bill to pass.

It is beyond clear: ICE cannot be reformed. It must be abolished — full
stop.

If any Senator votes to fund them, they're voting in support of murdering
our friends, families, and neighbors—and they should lose their jobs.

We don't want 10 paragraphs of mealy-mouthed excuses from Democrats
anymore: abolish ICE or f*ck off.

subject: We know how to defeat Trump

body:
Authoritarianism is not inevitable
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)
When Trump put kids in cages and separated mothers from their children during his first administration, Americans rose up, protested, confronted their representatives and forced the country to reckon with the evil being done in our name.
_Protest against family separation at the Tornillo immigration detention center, June 17, 2018._
Family separation was formally announced on May 7, 2018. Because of the intense, unrelenting public pressure to stop it, Trump was forced to rescind the order on June 20th of that same year, just 44 days later.
Operation Metro Surge, which has so far deployed 3,000+ federal agents to harass, kidnap, brutalize and kill the residents of Minnesota, began in early December. Because of the intense public documentation of the abuses and public protest in Minneapolis, including a general strike on January 23rd, and because of the national outrage over the murders of Renée Good and Alex Pretti, the hostage-taking of children, and the complete jackbooted thuggery of federal agents against their fellow Americans, Trump is beginning his retreat from Minnesota.
It is rare for Trump to rescind an executive order or retreat in the face of opposition. It only happens when the pressure from the American people is overwhelming.
In describing how power works in America, Abraham Lincoln said that the power of the people is the most awesome force in the country.
More powerful than the courts, the legislatures and even the presidency.
“Public sentiment is everything,” he said. “With public sentiment, nothing can fail. Without it, nothing can succeed.”
We must keep the pressure up, press the advantage that has been won at incredible sacrifice, and not only force the administration to continue its retreat but set the ground for overwhelming victory at the polls in November.
Heading into the 2018 midterms, Republicans held a 235–193 majority. Because of Trump’s deep unpopularity and because of the way in which protests had shaped public sentiment, Trump’s party lost 40 seats that year, giving Democrats a significant majority and their largest pickup since 1974.
Trump is even more unpopular today than he was in 2018. His margin in the House is even narrower (218-213). His policies are directly and very publicly killing people, including U.S. citizens. The brave people of Minneapolis are shaping public sentiment through their actions —documenting, protesting, and peacefully pushing back — and if we can follow their lead and keep up this pressure we have a real chance of winning political power in the 2026 midterms and stopping Trump.
As dark as these days are, let’s remember that we are not without power to fight back. Let’s acknowledge that there is a way through this. Take inspiration from those who risk their lives to document abuse and inform their fellow Americans, those who protest peacefully and break through to the conscience of this country, those who are unwilling to give up or give in.
Do what you can, with what you have, wherever you are. Keep up the fight.
-Beto

—
Resources:
* [Stand with Minnesota](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67477?t=3&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6) \- a directory of organizations helping Minnesotans to resist and survive the attack on their freedoms and lives.
* Keep the pressure on the Senate Democrats to vote no on DHS/ICE funding this week. This is our best near-term opportunity to provide a check on the abuses we’re seeing across the country:
* Senate switchboard: **(202) 224-3121.**
* [List of all Senators’ Twitter accounts](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67478?t=4&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)
* Join a protest or march. Seeing your neighbors exercise their first amendment rights in the freezing cold and in the face of this administration’s intimidation has a way of waking you up and focusing your attention. [Here is a listing of all related events in Mobilize](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67479?t=5&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6).
* Fund the candidates who must win. In addition to winning the House, we need to pick up Senate seats in November if we’re going to stop these abuses and ensure accountability for the crimes committed. While some primaries are still in play (Texas), we have nominees who could use your help right now:
\- [John Ossoff in Georgia](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67480?t=6&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)
\- [Roy Cooper in North Carolina](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67481?t=7&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)
\- [Sherrod Brown in Ohio](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67482?t=8&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)
\- [Mary Peltola in Alaska](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67483?t=9&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)

* Join our work to reach, register and turn out Texas voters targeted for voter suppression and intimidation by the state. Make them the margin of victory. [Volunteer with Powered by People.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67484?t=10&akid=240645%2E444211%2ErKbkD6)

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

In this episode of _**AMPED UP**_ , [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) are joined by writer and Substack author [Zuri Stevens](https://open.substack.com/users/15122028-zuri-stevens?utm_source=mentions) for a searing, deeply human conversation about state violence, racism, political cowardice, and the moral reckoning facing the country. Sparked by the killing of Alex Pretti by ICE agents in Minneapolis, the discussion moves from breaking political analysis to lived experience--examining how authoritarian tactics, propaganda, and dehumanization play out not just in headlines, but in real lives.
What emerges is both an indictment of power and a call to solidarity, empathy, and sustained resistance.
### 5 Key Takeaways
#### **1\. State Violence, ICE, and the Collapse of Accountability**
The conversation returned again and again to the killing of Alex Pretti and the government's delayed admission that he was never a domestic terrorist. What emerged was not confusion or uncertainty, but a familiar and disturbing pattern: overwhelming force first, narrative smearing second, and accountability pushed endlessly down the road. Schecter and Shuster spoke plainly about what it meant when ICE agents faced suspension instead of prosecution--and how that choice signaled just how normalized state violence has become.
#### **2\. Authoritarian Politics and Propaganda Over Truth**
The episode traced how the Trump administration responded to crisis not with responsibility, but with coordinated deflection and blame-shifting. What stood out was how deliberate the cruelty felt--not as a mistake or excess, but as a governing posture. Dehumanization was treated as a tool, useful for justifying violence and insulating those in power from consequence, even as real people paid the price.

* * *
#### **3\. The Political Backlash and Cracks in Trump 's Power**
Shuster walked through polling that showed Trump sinking on immigration and deportation--the very issue that once powered his rise. The discussion made clear that something had shifted: the public was recoiling faster than many politicians were willing to admit. The episode underscored how both Republicans and Democrats were increasingly exposed when they continued to defend or enable abusive enforcement in the face of growing opposition.
#### **4\. Zuri Stevens on Lived Experience, Trauma, and Racism**
Zuri Stevens grounded the conversation in lived reality, speaking not in abstractions but in the weight of what it feels like to watch state violence unfold again and again. She described the exhaustion, grief, and quiet vigilance that accompany daily life in a country where racism accumulates through moments that are easy to dismiss individually, but devastating in total.
#### **5\. Black Women, Humanity, and the Fight to Be Seen**
The episode closed on a deeply personal note, confronting how Black women are so often denied vulnerability and expected to endure injustice without breaking. Stevens pushed back against the "strong Black woman" myth, naming it for what it is: another way to strip people of their full humanity. What lingered was a shared understanding that empathy, solidarity, and collective resistance are no longer optional if dignity--and democracy itself--are to survive.

| | _**_A Personal Note from Senator Ted Cruz_**_
---
Peter, I'll keep this note brief and to the point because we don't have much time left. **_With the end-of-month deadline rapidly approaching, we 're in grave danger of _MISSING_ our January fundraising goal! _** I wish I could say I was surprised... But this is just another example of the trends we've been seeing for the last few months. Right now, far too many Republicans are sitting on the sidelines. _We 're seeing it in elections, we're seeing it in our voter verification numbers, we're seeing it in our fundraising, and frankly, _we 're even seeing it in the number of conservatives reading our emails_!_ _ _ But you're among the few % who opened. And I'm not surprised, because your record shows you're a top supporter, so you're among the few I can count on to read this email from start to finish, ${Recipient.FirstName}. **To be fully transparent - I don't have any checks left to cash or large pledges. Unlike the Democrats, I don't have left-wing mega-donors I can call up to bankroll our grassroots campaign. ** At this make-or-break moment, grassroots supporters like _YOU_ are _truly_ the last place left for me to turn. Peter, you've always had my back when I needed it most. With time running out, I have no choice but to ask for your support one final time. _(I understand that things are still tough as we recover from four years of Biden 's economy. If you're not in the position to donate right now - or if you've already given all that you can - please disregard what I'm about to ask. I mean it!)_ **But otherwise, please rush an urgent contribution of ANY amount - even just $10 if that's all you can spare - to help us reach our goal before the end-of-month deadline. name: Squad Victory Fund
subject: Ilhan was assaulted during last night’s town hall in Minnesota.
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260128-1876-foote&t=1001&akid=1876%2E342411%2Ekb1R5z ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

Last night during her town hall in Minneapolis, a man rushed Ilhan and
sprayed her with an unknown substance before being tackled to the ground.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260128-movement._-ag11&refcode=em20260128-1876&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1876%2E342411%2Ekb1R5z ]Headline: Representative Ilhan Omar Is Attacked at Town Hall in
Minneapolis.

Luckily, Ilhan is safe. But let’s be clear: this was an act of political
violence. Donald Trump and the far right have relentlessly smeared Ilhan
for years, stoking hate and encouraging threats against her and other
members of the Squad. This incident is the latest, and proof that their
attacks carry real danger, and we must take them seriously.

As long as Ilhan, Rashida, Ayanna, and Alexandria continue to speak out
bravely against the injustices being committed by this administration, we
know the threats against them will continue. We must do everything in our
power to protect them and their loved ones from every attack, physical and
otherwise, being leveled against them.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260128-movement._-ag11&refcode=em20260128-1876&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1876%2E342411%2Ekb1R5z ]Will you make a donation right now to help protect the Squad and make
sure they can keep fighting for us in Congress? Any amount, no matter how
large or small, makes a difference.

Campaign security is a necessary and growing expense for the Squad, and
it’s often paid for using campaign resources — resources that should be
going towards organizing, meeting with voters, and building the kind of
people-powered movement our communities deserve.

It’s beyond infuriating that, instead, campaign funds must now be used to
defend our champions against dangerous incidents like the one that
occurred during last night’s town hall.

But our champions don’t back down. It’s not who they are. In the moments
after she was assaulted, Ilhan had this to say:

“We will continue. These f*cking *ssholes are not going to get away with
this.”

She’s right,
Peter. And there has never been
a more urgent or important time to stand alongside her and the rest of our
Squad. Because this team refuses to be intimidated, and won’t let anyone
get away with putting them in harm’s way.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260128-movement._-ag11&refcode=em20260128-1876&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=1876%2E342411%2Ekb1R5z ]A donation of any size today will make all the difference. Together, we
can make sure the Squad has enough resources to stay safe and secure and
to continue leading our progressive movement in the halls of Congress.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260128-movement._-ag11&refcode=em20260128-1876&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1876%2E342411%2Ekb1R5z ]Contribute ››

In strength and solidarity,

The Squad Victory Fund

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.squadvictoryfund.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1876%2E342411%2Ekb1R5z

Paid for by The Squad Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Email us: info@squadvictoryfund.com

Hi there! Monica here from the AZ Dems finance team. Our January fundraising deadline is Saturday at midnight, and I wanted to share what we accomplished this month — and why your support matters. **Here's what we did in January:**
* We stood with Senator Mark Kelly as he fights back against Trump and Hegseth's unconstitutional attacks. Mark is now suing the Secretary of Defense, and we're making sure he knows Arizona has his back.
* We exposed Arizona Republicans' extremism when Warren Petersen, John Gillette, and Brad Miller pushed legislation to criminalize protesting ICE — while defending the agent who killed Renée Good, a U.S. citizen.
* We echoed Senator Ruben Gallego's warning that ICE could surge to Phoenix, and we're organizing to make sure Arizona families know their rights when federal agents engage in racial profiling and intimidation.
* We launched the When We Count Fellowship in Arizona — the DNC's largest voter registration program ever — to help us close the 330,000-voter registration gap and reach the 1.6 million unaffiliated voters who are up for grabs.

And we did all this while Republicans hope voters aren't paying attention to their alignment with white nationalists, their attacks on healthcare, and their blind deference to federal authority. **[Can you chip in before Saturday’s deadline to help us keep fighting?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124233319/597976928/1861397980?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20260128_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmE0Y2U4ZjItYTFmYy1mMDExLThkNGMtMDAyMjQ4MmQyNzliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZAZIJVXyMcoExNmAXoJicf1KB7ludOmFuUvwb3hgqPs=)** | [CHIP IN NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124233320/597976929/1861397980?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20260128_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmE0Y2U4ZjItYTFmYy1mMDExLThkNGMtMDAyMjQ4MmQyNzliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZAZIJVXyMcoExNmAXoJicf1KB7ludOmFuUvwb3hgqPs=)

The path to flipping the House runs through Arizona. And Democrats like Mark Kelly and Ruben Gallego are leading the national resistance to Trump's authoritarian agenda.

Sixteen years ago, the Supreme Court handed corporations a blank check in
Citizens United — and our democracy has been paying the price ever since.

That one decision opened the floodgates to unlimited corporate cash,
drowning out everyday people and rigging the system for billionaires and
special interests.

Corporations pad their profits. Lobbyists write the rules. And the
guardrails meant to protect the public interest are deliberately torn
down.

Now, the damage is spreading to the courts.

Donald Trump and his allies are working overtime to stack the federal
bench with loyalists who put politics, power, and corporate donors ahead
of the rule of law. These judges are the downstream consequence of
Citizens United: a captured system that rewards self-dealing and punishes
accountability.

Demand Justice PAC refuses to accept courts that serve the ultra-wealthy
instead of the Constitution.

We’re fighting for independent courts, holding senators in both parties

# [I'm not going to fund ICE's chaos](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=186133423&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg2MTMzNDIzLCJpYXQiOjE3Njk2NDQyNjIsImV4cCI6MTc3MjIzNjI2MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.zKpRKWXWxn3hJrnxRwQ5GoBEgvBgiYVy2Js09KjWh64)
### ICE is out of control
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jan 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL2ltLW5vdC1nb2luZy10by1mdW5kLWljZXMtY2hhb3M_.wswTqVhNtdw85rq-8DO1gcx3NAFor2-ngeu3cIqSono?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/im-not-going-to-fund-ices-chaos?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

As I look at what's happening across our country, what I hear from Michiganders is that people want public safety solutions that protect families, strengthen communities, and uphold the basic dignity of every person.
They want safety that comes from order - not fear.
That's why I stand with my colleagues in saying: **Not one more dollar should go to ICE, Department of Homeland Security** **Secretary Kristi Noem must be impeached, and we need an immediate, drastic, and transparent overhaul of ICE.** Every single one of Trump's ICE officials, from the very bottom to the very top, including senior leadership like Noem, must face justice for crimes they commit. Donald Trump needs to get ICE out of Minneapolis and American cities where they're causing damage and harm.
It's time for accountability.
Under Secretary Noem's leadership, the DHS and ICE have ignored the commonsense guidance of local leaders and instead pursued lawless tactics that have escalated fear and chaos.
Public safety isn't a place for partisan games.
When we empower federal agencies, we must do so with the understanding that they will uphold the law with respect and restraint - not wield authority in dangerous ways that make law‐abiding residents feel unsafe in their own neighborhoods.
Across Michigan, folks tell me the same thing: They want communities where kids can walk to school without worry, where families can thrive without fear of violent federal intervention, and where law enforcement officers are accountable to the people they serve.
**That 's what genuine public safety looks like.**
When Noem allows ICE to operate without transparency and when calls for oversight and reform go unanswered, we lose something essential: trust. And once trust is lost, it's extremely difficult to rebuild.
**That 's why ICE doesn't need a $75 billion slush fund, why Secretary Noem must be impeached and why we need an immediate, drastic, and transparent overhaul of ICE.**
With grit,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
